picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Hormuz carries about a fifth of global oil, so whether shipping normalizes shapes energy prices, inflation, and growth worldwide.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would complicate Federal Reserve policy, squeeze real wages, and push up borrowing costs across the economy.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 1.5% in Q4 2026?
picks.why: Fourth-quarter growth above 1.5% would signal the U.S. economy is still expanding at a healthy pace heading into 2027.

picks.question: OpenAI IPO closing market cap above $1.2T?
picks.why: An OpenAI listing above $1.2 trillion would test how much public investors will pay today for AI's future earnings.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: If AI can solve landmark open math problems, research itself may be automating, with large implications for scientific productivity.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab leads frontier AI influences where capital, talent, and market power concentrate in a strategically important industry.
